units.source_text: 从南禅寺山门到天接庵客厅的一段距离，非鸟儿是飞越不过去的。

en.t: The distance from the Sanmon gate of Nanzenji to the guest room of Tenseian was one that only a bird could fly across.

units.source_text: 然而，时过数年，我渐渐缩短了那段距离，如今好歹总像是到达了彼岸。

en.t: Yet as several years passed, I gradually shortened that distance, and now I somehow felt as though I had reached the far shore.

units.source_text: 从那时候起，我就一分一秒地细细计算着时间，终于确实地接近了意味着天接庵神秘的情景的东西了。

en.t: From that time on, I counted the time carefully, minute by minute and second by second, until at last I truly drew near to the thing that signified the mysterious scene of Tenseian.
I felt that I had to do this.

units.source_text: 如同远方的星光射到之时，地面上的面貌早已发生了变化一样，这女入完全变质了。

en.t: Just as the face of the earth has already changed by the time the light of a distant star reaches it, this woman had completely changed in nature.
There was nothing that could be done about it.

units.source_text: 再说，假如我从南禅寺山门上望见的时候就注定我和她今天会结合在一起的话，

en.t: Besides, if it had been destined from the moment I saw her from the Sanmon gate of Nanzenji that she and I would be joined together today,

units.source_text: 那么这种变形，只需稍稍修正就可复原，再度以当年的我和当年的她相见了。

en.t: then this transformation would need only the slightest correction to be restored, and we could meet again as the person I was then and the person she was then.
